exposure: Parecoxib (40 mg IV bolus every 12h x 4) plus Paracetamol (1000 mg IV infusion every 8h)
Placebo NaCl 0.9% IV bolus plus Paracetamol (1000 mg IV infusion every 8h)
cohort: The study participants were preeclampsia patients who underwent spinal anesthesia for cesarean section.
finding: In preeclampsia patients undergoing cesarean delivery, parecoxib administration significantly lowered VAS values after 12 hours and influenced IL-1b levels after 24 hours, but did not significantly affect IL-6 or PGE2 levels.
